narratives.title: Report export lacks an ownership check
narratives.overview: `/api/reports/:id/export` loads the report by id and returns `confidentialNotes` without an authorization check that the report belongs to the caller, so any authenticated user can export another user's report (IDOR).

narratives.title: SQL injection in report search
narratives.overview: `/api/reports/search` interpolates the query string into the SQL statement.

examples.name: rejects a missing rate limit claim

narratives.title: Missing rate limit on exports
narratives.overview: The export endpoint has no rate limiting, so a caller can exhaust server resources.
